description: What only the DRV8962 motor driver has: a current limit per channel, clearing a fault and reading it. Driving the channels is the Motor block.

activation.text: Runs every pass while enabled: a limit is sent when it changes, clearing a fault once on each rising enable, a reading on every pass.

variants.description: Sets the chopping current limit of a channel; the reference voltage follows the largest limit. 0 means no limit.
Clears the fault latches of a channel with a sleep-pin reset pulse once on each rising enable. The channel brakes.

activation.text: Clears the fault once each time the block is enabled.

variants.description: Reads whether a channel has a fault and why: overcurrent, thermal or undervoltage, or external. The same faults are also events an On event block can react to.

activation.text: Reads on every pass while enabled.
